newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Aurora Biosciences Corp.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Aurora Biosciences Corp.

text.p: Total shares to be offered 3.0 million
Shrs offered by shareholders x.x million Shrs outstanding after ipo 15,893,814
Lead Underwriter Alex. Brown & Sons Inc

Underwriters over-allotment 450,000 shrs Business: Aurora, based in La Jolla, Calif., designs and develops proprietary drug discovery systems, services and technologies to accelerate and enhance the discovery of new medicines.

Use of Proceeds: Working capital and general corporate purposes, including facilities expansion and improvements, capital equipment purchases, enchancement of internal research and development capabilties and the acquisition of chemical libraries.
